# Initial vehicle location and orientation
initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5)
initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the kraz vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle = veh.Kraz()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain

patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis.SetWindowTitle('Kraz Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 25.0, 1.5)

vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetTractor())

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

render_frame = 0

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

    # Get driver inputs

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# 1. Initialize the Chrono engine and create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set gravity
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# 2. Create the terrain (rigid terrain with friction and restitution)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
terrain.Initialize()

# Set terrain material properties
material = terrain.GetMaterialSurface()
material.SetFriction(0.8)        # Example friction coefficient
material.SetRestitution(0.1)     # Example restitution coefficient

# Create a ground plane
ground = terrain.GetGround()
ground.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
ground.SetMaterialSurface(material)

# 3. Create the Kraz vehicle
# Define initial position and orientation
initial_pos = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0)  # Slightly above ground
initial_rot = chrono.Q_from_AngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))

# Instantiate the vehicle
kraz_vehicle = veh.Kraz(vehicle::ChContactMethod::NSC)
kraz_vehicle.Initialize(initial_pos, initial_rot, system)

# Set vehicle initial conditions if needed
kraz_vehicle.GetChassis().SetPos(initial_pos)
kraz_vehicle.GetChassis().SetRot(initial_rot)

# 4. Set up the driver system for vehicle control
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver()
driver.Initialize(system, kraz_vehicle.GetVehicle())

# 5. Set up the Irrlicht visualization
vis = irr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Kraz Vehicle Simulation')
vis.Initialize()

# Configure camera
camera_pos = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 3, -10)
look_at = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0)
vis.GetActiveCamera().SetPosition(camera_pos)
vis.GetActiveCamera().SetTarget(look_at)

# Add lights
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 10, -10),  # Light position
                       chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0),     # Target
                       100,                         # Radius
                       0.5, 0.5, 0.5,               # Diffuse color
                       0.3, 0.3, 0.3,               # Specular color
                       0.2)                         # Shadow intensity

# 6. Simulation loop parameters
time_step = 1e-3
max_time = 20  # seconds
current_time = 0

# 7. Run the simulation
while vis.Run():
    # Synchronize driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(current_time)
    driver.Advance(time_step)

    # Apply driver inputs to vehicle
    kraz_vehicle.GetVehicle().GetPowertrain().SetThrottle(driver.GetThrottle());
    kraz_vehicle.GetVehicle().GetSteering().SetSteering(driver.GetSteering());

    # Synchronize vehicle
    kraz_vehicle.Synchronize(current_time)

    # Advance the system
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

    # Update visualization
    vis.Render()

    # Increment time
    current_time += time_step

    # Optional: add a real-time check or limit
    # time.sleep(time_step)  # Uncomment if needed for real-time pacing

# Create terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(
    patch_mat,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    terrainLength,
    terrainWidth
)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create Irrlicht visualization
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('Kraz Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 25.0, 10.5)  # Adjusted distance
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetTractor())

# Create driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set driver input response times
steering_time = 1.0
throttle_time = 1.0
braking_time = 0.3
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetTractor().GetMass())

# Number of steps between renders
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize timer and counters
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene at specified intervals
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Implement double lane change maneuver based on simulation time
    # Define maneuver parameters
    maneuver_start_time = 2.0  # seconds
    maneuver_duration = 4.0  # seconds total for both lane changes
    lane_change_angle = math.radians(20)  # maximum steering angle in radians

    # Determine steering input based on time
    if time >= maneuver_start_time and time <= (maneuver_start_time + maneuver_duration / 2):
        # First lane change: steer right
        phase_time = time - maneuver_start_time
        # Linear interpolation from 0 to lane_change_angle
        steering_input = (phase_time / (maneuver_duration / 2)) * lane_change_angle
    elif time > (maneuver_start_time + maneuver_duration / 2) and time <= (maneuver_start_time + maneuver_duration):
        # Second lane change: steer left back to 0
        phase_time = time - (maneuver_start_time + maneuver_duration / 2)
        steering_input = lane_change_angle - (phase_time / (maneuver_duration / 2)) * lane_change_angle
    else:
        # No maneuver
        steering_input = 0

    # Apply steering input to driver
    driver.SetSteering(steering_input)

    # Advance all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment step counter
    step_number += 1

    # Maintain real-time simulation
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
